title: Seed fixed timestamps in sign_in_google_signout_throws_test.dart instead of DateTime.now() in device-account fixtures
why: `_seedAccounts` and the inline local-conflict account both call `DateTime.now()` for createdAt/lastUsedAt. No assertion in this file currently depends on the exact value, so it isn't causing flakiness today, but it's an unseeded wall-clock read in a test file, and the exact sibling problem (device-account fixture timestamps) is already solved with a fixed clock constant one directory over in account_picker_screen_l1_test.dart and sign_in_wrong_password_no_callback_test.dart within this same batch.
recommendation: Replace DateTime.now() with a fixed constant (e.g. `final _kNow = DateTime.utc(2026, 1, 1);`), matching the convention already used by sibling files in this batch.
acceptance_criteria: No DateTime.now() call remains in sign_in_google_signout_throws_test.dart; fixture timestamps use a fixed constant.
